name: SlidesAI
tagline: SlidesAI is a Google Workspace add-on that converts any text, document, or topic into a presentation in Google Slides automatically. It selects themes, layouts, and summarises content into concise slide points. Educators and business users use it to transform long documents into presentation-ready decks in seconds.
